definitions.gloss: to crawl out; to creep out; to emerge by crawling
definitions.explanation: To move out of an enclosed or confined space by crawling. Used for insects, babies, or people in tight spaces. Can also be used figuratively for emerging from a difficult situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}してきた。
examples.english: A bug crawled out of the hole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The baby crawled out from under the blanket.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{崩|くず}れた→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{生存者|せいぞんしゃ}→生存者：21241_seizonsha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}してきたとき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{皆|みな}→皆：01810_mina⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: Everyone shed tears when survivors crawled out from under the collapsed building after the earthquake.

notes:
A compound verb meaning to emerge from a space by crawling. Used for insects, babies, or people in confined spaces. Can also be figurative for escaping a difficult situation.

FORMS:
⟦{這|は}う→這う：00094_hau⟧ (to crawl) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to come out).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}す: to crawl out of a hole
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}す: to crawl out of bed/futon
- {這|は}い{出|だ}してくる: to come crawling out (toward the speaker)
- ⟦{瓦礫|がれき}→瓦礫：30524_gareki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}す: to crawl out from under rubble

USAGE:
Often paired with てくる to indicate motion toward the speaker: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{這|は}い{出|だ}してきた (a bug came crawling out).
